title: [finding] a raw REST `PATCH` on a PR **body** appends the bare attribution footer regardless of what was sent (+58 bytes) — a body sent with its own footer stores TWO; `platform-readings.md` documents the create/comment cells but not this one
body:
Measured twice on PR #18608 today by the `domain:spec` lane and recorded rather than dropped. ⛔ Filed for the `domain:skills` seat because the fix is one line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, which is a **governed surface** — ⛔ not this seat's to edit.

## The reading

A raw REST `PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}` carrying a `body` **appends the bare footer block** — newline, newline, rule line, newline, `_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_` — **irrespective of what the sent body contains**. Exactly **+58 bytes**, measured twice.

⇒ A body sent **with** its own footer is stored with **TWO**. The repair is to re-send a freshly composed, footer-free body and read back until the stored copy carries exactly one.

## Why it is worth a line in the fact table

`platform-readings.md` already covers the neighbouring cells — comment **creation** appending its own footer, and MCP-versus-REST differing — and those cells are documented precisely because they disagree with each other. **This fills the REST/edit cell for a PR body**, which is the one a seat hits when it refreshes a PR body before landing. ⚠️ And refreshing a PR body before landing is standing practice in this lane, because the repo squashes and the body becomes the permanent commit message on `main` — so this is on a path seats take deliberately, not an exotic one.

⚠️ Cost of not recording it: a seat that composes a careful body *with* the attribution lines the session is told to append will silently double them, and the doubling is invisible unless the body is read back and the footers counted. That read-back is exactly the discipline the table exists to prescribe.

## Suggested shape

One row/line in the existing 配额段 or 写侧 table, in the same form as the comment-creation note (「评论创建通道自己追加页脚(+58/59 字节)—— 自己别发」), extended to say the PR-body PATCH channel does the same.

⚠️ Re-measure before writing the line: this was measured on one repo on one day, and +58 versus +59 already differs between the documented comment cell and this one. The byte count may be a function of the rule-line spelling.

Dedupe words: `PR body PATCH double footer`, `REST appends attribution footer`, `platform-readings REST edit cell`, `+58 bytes bare footer`, `refresh PR body before landing squash`.
